status: frozen before full-calibration fit and before holdout access
motivation: The v7 physical replay passes the pooled three-channel gate but has a lights-off cold residual and fails temperature in four compartments. Public data identify the 10 x 9.6 m footprint and mixed exterior/corridor/neighbor boundaries but not the thermal coupling needed for a unique mechanistic correction.
development_disclosure: The model class was chosen after inspecting v7 calibration residuals. A one-time early-to-late calibration diagnostic showed feasibility, so neither that diagnostic nor the full calibration fit is confirmatory validation.
base_model: Frozen v7 GreenLight replay with v5 physical parameters, floor-normalized lighting, boundary initialization, and bounded loss-compensated pipe-state tracking.

correction_scope.feedback: The correction is not fed back into GreenLight latent dynamics.

model.standardization: calibration mean and population standard deviation; constant columns use scale 1
model.target: observed air temperature minus v7 GreenLight air temperature
model.fit_data: all 1,200 hourly samples in the 21 frozen pre-holdout calibration sequences
model.selection: No feature, regularization, or model-class search after this freeze.

calibration_reporting: Report corrected and uncorrected metrics pooled and by compartment. Calibration fit is an implementation check, not validation evidence.
holdout_rule: After coefficients and their hashes are frozen, evaluate exactly once on every input-eligible holdout sequence. Do not refit, change features, alter lambda, add compartment identity, or change the gate after reading holdout outcomes.
holdout_gate: Apply configs/agc2019_climate_validation_gate_v0.json to corrected tAir and uncorrected rhIn/co2InPpm, pooled and for every compartment, with 100% solver completion and zero sampled physical violations.
claim_boundary: A pass establishes temporal generalization of a hybrid GreenLight plus statistical air-temperature observation layer under observed actions in these AGC compartments. It does not validate latent crop dynamics, energy counterfactuals, or a fully mechanistic digital twin.
